content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research focuses on photocatalytic degradation of micropollutants in pharmaceutical and municipal wastewater using advanced oxidation processes with TiO2 catalysts.","sources":[{"id":"R0947","field":"bio","quote":"Her research focuses on environmental chemistry and water treatment, with particular emphasis on the photocatalytic degradation of micropollutants"}]},{"text":"Develops and evaluates immobilised TiO2 photocatalytic membrane systems for continuous-flow water treatment with assessment of fouling management through backwashing.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09969","field":"abstract","quote":"immobilised on a porous alumina support by dip-coating and calcination, yielding a stable thin-film catalyst"}]},{"text":"Conducted field campaigns and pilot-scale studies monitoring seasonal variation in treatment performance and operational conditions at wastewater facilities.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09972","field":"abstract","quote":"The system was installed at a wastewater treatment facility in Novi Sad and operated during summer and autumn field campaigns"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher's expertise in photocatalytic membrane systems [SYN-PUB-09969] and fouling management addresses membrane technology, but the focus is on pharmaceutical micropollutants rather than the complex organic foulants (fats, proteins, sugars) causing rapid biofouling in MBR systems for dairy wastewater [R0947]."}
